# `aitbc blockchain backup`

Back up chain data to a directory with optional compression and verify.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc blockchain backup [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | yes | The Chain id. |
| `--path` | text | — | no | Backup directory path |
| `--compress` | flag | `false` | no | Compress backup |
| `--verify` | flag | `false` | no | Verify backup integrity |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc blockchain backup --chain-id <chain_id>
```
